raw.title: Fix: #37. x-jsonld keywords.
raw.body:
## This PR

- adds x-jsonld-type and x-jsonld-context Extensions to OAS 3.0
- these extensions are used to attach semantic information to OpenAPI 3.0 Schema Objects.
- fix https://github.com/OAI/spec.openapis.org/issues/37

## Notes

- [x] I successfully built the pages on docker.
